notes.semetey-1-2013:p0084:b003:l001: Read entire left column before entire right column, visually checked against individual PDF image. Legacy-font-v1 normalization retains original glyphs and exact source coordinates. No prior English translation used.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0085:b003:l001: Three scoundrels killed is explicit and retained beside subsequent six living enemies, without numerical harmonization.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0086:b003:l001: Read entire left column before entire right column, visually checked against individual PDF image. Legacy-font-v1 normalization retains original glyphs and exact source coordinates. No prior English translation used.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0084:b003:l004: Мура provisionally understood as wish/aim in the мурат idiom жетүү, rather than material inheritance; exact shortened form merits specialist review.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0084:b003:l005: Туяк literally hoof, conventional surviving child/heir metaphor; Manas is the deceased khan.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0084:b003:l009: Ак тинте is Kanykei’s named dagger Aktinte, not an unspecified white object. Primary Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/тинте/ explicitly identifies her dagger. Speech contemplates self-sacrifice; retained as narrative.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0084:b003:l010: Өлгөндө көргөн idiom: child attained after extreme suffering/long hope, not a child literally seen after speaker’s death.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0084:b003:l011: Printed continuation калайын! at b003:l012 is right-indented wrap of this verse, individually inspected. Both source fragments preserved and joined with a space; counted once.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0084:b003:l015: Желе тартат provisionally renders the crane’s stretched line of flight over open country; not an asserted species-specific migration fact.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0084:b003:l016: Калдайган кара баш literal large dark head; idiomatic living self rendered with head still on shoulders, not a statement about skin color.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0084:b003:l022: Амалы provisionally capacity/strength in the starving child’s context; subject follows in23. English source-row order retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0084:b003:l025: Giving the breast/nursing is explicit; no invented milk supply or diagnosis.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0084:b003:l027: Биз долу plural self-description, distraught/frantic women, not psychiatric diagnosis.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0084:b003:l030: Read30 noble man’s surviving child then31 bereft of only child. Initial drafting reversal corrected during paired review.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0084:b003:l034: Талоолоп qualified streaming/spreading blood here; source explicitly soles/dark blood. Not the separate dictionary талоо pillaging sense; precise adverbial nuance merits review.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0084:b003:l036: Канчыгың bitch retained as Kanykei’s harsh self-description, not softened away.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0084:b004:l001: Конобу settle/stop in valley, rhetorical fear of death given succeeding extinguished-fire image; no invented burial event.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0084:b004:l003: Lion gone to other world in3, losing his heir in4: source-row order retained after correcting initial reversed English phrases.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0084:b004:l007: Өө exclamation and blood from mouth explicitly retained, no medical interpretation.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0084:b004:l012: Бел pun ridge/waist/support, with girding. Provisional ridge reading follows departure-from construction13–14 and support-ridge parallel86:25–26; alternative bodily waist nuance remains material.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0084:b004:l019: Speaker fears being blamed for carrying child away and causing death; retain her wording rather than rewriting child’s plot outcome.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0084:b004:l024: Mountain spur collapse metaphor, not literal geological event; түгөнгөн exhausted/crumbling qualified.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0084:b004:l026: Кабак bank/steep sheltering edge here, not eyelid.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0084:b004:l027: Жалмалатар let devour, hunger intensifier retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0084:b004:l032: Кол troop/armed following taken from people, not literal hands. Same structure35.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0084:b004:l033: Күлазык preserved travel provision; glossary asterisk is apparatus, not an English word or extra verse.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0084:b004:l038: Бир туткан бири al: one trusted support; exact elliptical syntax rendered provisionally without adding a new named person.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0084:b004:l039: Кат written text/letter; qualified written charm in spiritual Aikojo context, not a fabricated message’s contents.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0085:b003:l005: Байгамбар чалыш resembles a prophet, not assertion Bakai is a canonical prophet.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0085:b003:l006: Жооп answer/advice sought before departure, not invented permission or letter.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0085:b003:l008: Manas’s countless possessions8 and scattered9 remain separate aligned verse rows.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0085:b003:l010: Self-directed curse upon womanhood retained as character’s language, not narrator endorsement.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0085:b003:l015: Бок literally shit; explicit contempt for transient world preserved.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0085:b003:l017: Казы fatty horse-belly meat. Жебес would not eat retained, contrasting formerly fastidious abundance with thirst; not silently changed to no horse fat available.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0085:b003:l023: Dawn-knows-dawn proverb: tomorrow’s provision unknown, not an omitted verse or summary of24–25.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0085:b003:l029: Тууган kin, not necessarily biological mother giving birth; condemnation of recognizing six enemies as family.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0085:b003:l031: Туйгун prized goshawk; noble goshawk preserves class/quality without unverifiable taxonomic precision.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0085:b003:l032: Тунжур female goshawk, primary Yudakhin/1969/2015 https://el-sozduk.kg/тунжур/, latter quotes exact verse. Hen comparison applied to child retained; not changed to male or fledgling.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0085:b003:l034: Тынар valued hunting hawk and figurative support; primary https://el-sozduk.kg/тынар/. No unsupported species or age classification. Nest succession metaphor retained36.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0085:b004:l002: Printed болучу positive used to be, contrary to repeated болобу rhetorical questions. Retained as positive wording with material uncertainty; not silently supplied a negation.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0085:b004:l003: Printed адам оңобу? b004:l004 is indented continuation of same verse. Joined with space and both source IDs retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0085:b004:l012: Spilled bowl image retained as rhetorical impossibility, not literal refill procedure.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0085:b004:l015: Карын belly as seat of grief; translated fill belly with sorrow, qualified idiomatic expansion.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0085:b004:l017: Ор pit in a death/grief threat, rendered grave; no actual digging event asserted.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0085:b004:l018: Кайнат/шор boil/bitter lot pun;18 verb and19 object remain on their own lines. Not literal cooking.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0085:b004:l022: Жер тартат earth draws, omen/premonition of joy; supernatural/figurative wording retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0085:b004:l023: Абасы refers to child’s elder/uncle Bakai; kin title need not be biological uncle.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0085:b004:l028: Көңүлү жаман бөлүндү mind seriously troubled/distracted, rather than an invented positive change before she recognizes rider.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0085:b004:l029: Кал басып көз qualified age-clouded eyes in elder’s context, not a clinical diagnosis; exact obstruction nuance merits specialist review.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0085:b004:l034: Тумшук promontory, nose metaphor of landscape; next mountain spur confirms not rider’s nose.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0085:b004:l037: Ak-Kyia printed place-name retained; no unsupported modern location assignment.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0086:b003:l005: Кадыр түн holy Night of Power simile here, qualified auspicious relief; noun түн repeated. Distinct from earlier Manas1832:2 human seer epithet.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0086:b003:l009: Ачылган жерим жабылды exposed place covered, restoration-of-protection image retained rather than wound diagnosis.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0086:b003:l010: Аяш husband’s friend relationship, not an invented lover or literal biological uncle.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0086:b003:l014: Extinguished fire, revived soul, gathered people, fattened horse, fed stomach are anticipatory relief metaphors upon seeing Bakai; no fabricated intervening feeding events.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0086:b003:l017: Чачылган баш collective scattered people/lives provisionally, not literal dismembered head reassembly.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0086:b003:l025: Бел/кыр ridge and supporting backbone pun continues26; landscape preserved rather than flattened to generic support.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0086:b003:l029: Түзөңү кайкаң broad sweeping shore/plain landscape around lake provisionally; exact epithet merits review, no named lake invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0086:b003:l031: Бир = пир spiritual guide attested primary https://el-sozduk.kg/БИР/; twelve-guide allegiance formula, not number12plus1. Same36 right column.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0086:b003:l034: Бекер боздоп этели printed awkward clause retained as fruitless lament, not silently changed to stop weeping; succeeding smile request differs in tone.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0086:b003:l038: Кетирген causative sent away retained for Bakai; no attempt to reconcile blame with joy at his arrival.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0086:b003:l039: Кемтик lack/loss, көрүп тоюнсун see and be satisfied, qualified bitter appeal to see orphan/loss; do not add specific meal.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0086:b004:l001: Banner and gift/heir metaphors address surviving child carried to Bakai; source-row order retained rather than inventing separate ceremonial equipment.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0086:b004:l006: Тентигеним first-person wandering retained within Chyiyrdy’s speech.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0086:b004:l013: Large dark head idiomatic self retained; not an inference about skin color.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0086:b004:l014: Torn bloody face and swollen wounds explicitly source mourning/flight bodily description; no added treatment or diagnosis.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0086:b004:l017: Hair grasped by strands and spread loose: dishevelment/lament, no invented assailant.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0086:b004:l019: Age32 explicit, not harmonized with ages elsewhere.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0086:b004:l021: Канкор blood-drinker laudatory fierce-warrior epithet retained, not literal new allegation.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0086:b004:l022: Both22 and23 repeat fewer than40days since death; retained in full.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0086:b004:l025: Кыркы сына элек qualified fortieth-day mourning observance not yet completed; no invented date. Quran chant24 remains separate.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0086:b004:l026: Карабет disgraced self-description, not black skin; elliptical first-person subject supplied from speaker.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0086:b004:l030: Year and six months both not elapsed, repeated temporal constraints retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0086:b004:l032: Аба elder/uncle respectful title; no unsupported biological genealogy.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0086:b004:l036: Twelve spiritual guides allegiance modifies saintly Bakai37; awkward enjambment preserved rather than moving content across verse IDs.
